blueprint.label: Space Science (1 silo)
blueprint.description: One rocket silo, ~2.9 space science/s (1000 per launch); place ~15 for a full belt. 2x1 cells. Makes its own rocket fuel (40 assemblers, light oil by pipe) and satellites. Inputs on the east edge, marked by panels: processing units, LDS, solar panels, accumulators, radars (yellow), solid fuel (blue), light oil (pipe).
